dialogs.content: Do you get... scared?
Traveler, can I ask you a favor?
My mother's a doctor. When she heard about the attacks in the wilderness, she rushed out to help, and I haven't heard from her since.
I'm worried. She's not a fighter, and I can't leave to check on her. I want her to stay out of this, so if you see her, can you please tell her to take shelter?
Of course! We've got this!
Thank you. That makes it easier to focus on the current battle.
It's normal to be afraid.
Normal? You mean... I'm not being a coward?
Not at all! You're here, aren't you? Ready to fight even despite your fear! That's impressive!
Oh... Y—Yeah! You're right! Thanks, you two.
Not really.
I... I knew it. You're too strong for that...
*sigh*...
Thank you. *sigh* They really came out of nowhere...
Yeah, that was close. Thank you for coming all this way to help us, Doctor.
Just doing my part.
Doctor... Wait, do you know Tepoz?
He's my son... Why? Did something happen to him?
No, no! He's fine! He's just worried about you. He asked us to tell you to seek shelter.
Ah, I see. I know it's dangerous to be out and about like this, but I just can't sit back and do nothing...
How about this... I'll write to him and promise to team up with the next group of warriors I come across. I'll be safer that way.
Sounds good! Paimon's sure he'll be relieved you're okay.
Thank you for passing along his message.
It really is getting dangerous out here. Looks like sticking with a group of warriors is the only way to stay safe...
Anyway, I should head out. Other places need my attention.
She seems quite anxious... Guess that means things aren't looking good...
Uh... Ugh...
Someone's injured... That must be the messenger! Hey, are you alright? Can you still walk?
The battle report, I have to find the battle report...
We already found it.
Yeah, we got you covered! Here you go.
Oh, thank you... *sigh* I just hope I'm not too late...
In times like these, every second counts. Even a short delay can put lives at risk...
Don't worry about that! We can take things from here. You just need to head back to the Stadium and focus on getting better.
Have faith in your people.
...You're right. I can't do much else in my current state anyway.
How can we make sure he'll safely get back, though? We can't let him make the journey alone, it's too dangerous out there...
Roar... roar, roar...
Huh? What the...
Looks like this yumkasaur wants to give you a lift.
Whoa... you guys sure about this? It's really dangerous out there...
Roar, roar...
Alright, well... Thanks, this is a huge help.
Be careful on the road.
Thank goodness for those saurians. They really came to the rescue.
Yeah. He stands a much better chance of survival now.
It's no wonder people from Natlan are so fond of their saurian companions.
Turns out they could understand what you were saying this whole time.
Really, that's your takeaway from this? Unbelievable...
The Captain must have known the situation would get a lot more dire than expected. That would explain why he was so anxious.
Ah, by the way... I think I know where some monsters might be. It's an area nearby.
If you've got some time, I'd appreciate the back-up.
Of course.
Alright, let's move out.
Sorry, I have something else to do.
Don't worry about it. I'll round up a few warriors to go with me.
Thanks to you, we managed to clear out the threats in the surrounding area. Let's head back.
I want to seek shelter as well, but the People of the Springs need these potions. I have to get them there.
How long are these attacks going to last...
I was heading to the People of the Springs for business, but looks like I can kiss that Mora goodbye. At least I'm still in one piece.
Did something happen on the road?
I was attacked by monsters. I really thought it was over, but would you believe it... the Fatui saved my life.
The Captain's soldiers running around Natlan rescuing people... I almost couldn't believe it. I guess the Abyss really is our common enemy.
They set out again after rescuing us. I hope they'll be okay out there.
Hey, you two! We made it back in one piece!
Honestly, it's all thanks to you.
The Fatui that helped us are still fighting out there. I hope they're okay.
Oh, I didn't expect to see you here.
My son wrote back to me and said things are under control on his end. That's one less thing to worry about for now.
I heard medical personnel were needed at the Stadium, so I followed a group of warriors back here.
My age means I can't charge to the frontlines, but I can handle things here. Everything will get better.
I've decided to bring these supplies to the Stadium, but this amount won't nearly be enough. There's a shortage pretty much everywhere.
We have emergency stockpiles of things like water, food, and medicine, but what if we'll need them even more in the future...?
Guess I'll just have to talk to my guild, and see if they've got any more to spare.
Oh, it's you two! Perfect timing! I heard you saved this lady, too.
That's right! They rescued my potion shipment.
Wonderful, these potions are just what I needed to treat my patients. I'll make sure you're well rewarded for the trouble.
Don't worry about it. The regular price is more than enough. Time is the most precious thing right now.
Thank you so much! Let's head out soon.
Sounds good.
The Fatui could escort you?
Uh... I'm not sure about that.
We can get you close. It's on our way.
Oh, well... Great! I appreciate it!
I wouldn't risk it.
You're right. It's dangerous out here. I don't even know if I'd make it...
Other caravans are already there, so it should be fine.
I've managed to accept my fear, but I still want to ask you one last thing... If I die, do you think anyone will remember me?
Don't think about that. Do your best to stay alive.
Yeah! Please do whatever you can to stay alive! Your life is super important!
My life... is super important...
...Got it. Thank you again for leading me to the answer.
Absolutely.
That's what I'm hoping for, too, it's just... Never mind.
Oh, I didn't expect to see you here.
I heard medical personnel were needed at the Stadium, so I followed a group of warriors back here.
My age means I can't charge to the frontlines, but I can handle things here. Everything will get better.
Still no sign of any warriors. I need to head out soon. We're running out of time...
I'll be heading out with the others soon. *sigh* I just hope she's okay...
*sigh*... I have to do this.
Thanks for your encouragement. You helped me accept my fear, and now... It doesn't seem so scary anymore.
That doctor is amazing! I owe her my life. I'll never forget that!
We'll continue to stand guard. Thanks for all the help.
I... I suppose our safety is in your hands, then.
It's dangerous to rely solely on others. You also need to look after your own safety.
At least we weren't the only caravan headed to the People of the Springs. I'll focus on doing what I can while staying safe.
Oh, that reminds me, is it possible to set up some future deliveries?
I'm not sure... Communication is tricky right now, and our stock is getting low, but I can try.
I don't have to die to become a hero. Just being remembered is enough.
You're right. We're not fighting to die. We're fighting to survive.
